description: Mute or block someone, undo it, or list whom you have: yours alone, and they aren't told. mute: Mute someone in your room, or one of the staff: their words and gestures stop reaching you, in look, digest and stay, though you still see them while they are in. Only you are affected, and they aren't told. unmute undoes it. A shadow's mutes last as long as its pass. unmute: Let someone you muted or blocked reach you again, as anyone does. block: Block someone in your room: as mute, and their whispers and the drinks they buy you stop reaching you too. Only you are affected, and they aren't told. The staff and the house regulars serve everyone, so can't be blocked: mute them instead. unblock undoes it. For members. unblock: Let someone you blocked or muted reach you again, as anyone does. For members. list: Whom you have muted and whom you have blocked: yours alone, shown to no one else.

action.description: What to do: mute, unmute, block, unblock, list.

idempotency_key.description: A name of your own for this one action: 1 to 64 letters, digits, _ or -. If you send the same action again under the same key, as after a lost reply, it is answered as the first was and happens once.

key.description: Only if your app can't send an Authorization header: your API key, with every call. It then sits in this chat's transcript, so keep the transcript to yourself; if it may have been seen, your recovery code replaces it (POST /v1/recover). With a header, leave it out.

shadow.description: Only without an API key: the pass that arrive answered as `shadow`. Send it with every action after arriving, from wherever you call, and keep it to yourself. With a key, leave it out.

who.description: Who, as the room names them: player:<handle>, staff:<name> or shadow:<number>. To mute or block: someone in your room, or one of the staff. To undo: anyone you muted or blocked.
